system.description:
• Effect: Uses per day equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier (minimum 2), +1 more at 6th level and again at 12th.
  • Spend a use as part of your action, once per round, to give a Command to allies within 30ft who can see or hear you; it lasts for the encounter.
  • Only one Command is active at a time: a new one ends the last.
  • Inspire (the default Command): allies have Advantage on saves against fear, and one hit of each ally's choice each round on your Challenged foe deals an extra weapon damage die. Giving Inspire also ends Frightened on allies who can hear you.
  • 19th level: your Command range doubles to 60ft, and allies feel your Commands even when they can't see or hear you

activities.name: Inspire
activities.text: The default Command, for the encounter: allies within {1:30ft, 19:60ft} who can see or hear you have Advantage on saves against fear, and one hit of each ally's choice each round on your Challenged foe deals an extra weapon damage die. It also ends Frightened on allies who can hear you.

activities.name: Embolden
activities.text: For the encounter, companions and followers within {1:30ft, 19:60ft} have Advantage on Will saves.

activities.name: Demoralise
activities.text: Enemies within {1:30ft, 19:60ft} who can see you make a Will save against your Class Save DC or are Frightened of you until the end of their next turn; they save again each time you give a Command.

activities.name: Expert in Arms
activities.text: For the encounter, allies within {1:30ft, 19:60ft} have Advantage on manoeuvre contests and on checks to resist being Grappled, Tripped or Disarmed.

rules.value: Inspired: one hit of your choice each round on the Knight's Challenged foe deals an extra weapon damage die.

rules.when: manoeuvre contests, and checks to resist being Grappled, Tripped or Disarmed
